title: Spinach and Red Onion Omelette with Brown Roll
description: A simple three-egg omelette with spinach and red onion, served with a brown roll.

ingredients.name: egg
ingredients.preparation: assume medium-large eggs of about 60 g each

preparationSteps.instruction: Peel and finely slice the red onion.
Rinse and drain the spinach, unless it is already washed and ready to eat.
Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add the measured black pepper and salt, then beat until combined.
Measure the olive oil and set out the frying pan, spatula, serving plate, and brown roll.

steps.instruction: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced red onion and cook until slightly softened.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted.
Pour the prepared egg mixture into the pan.
Cook until the eggs are set, folding the omelette if preferred.

notes: Calories are estimates. Assumes eggs at about 72 kcal each, 1 tsp olive oil at about 40 kcal, spinach at about 23 kcal per 100 g, red onion at about 40 kcal per 100 g, and a 70 g brown roll at about 170 kcal. The original 473 kcal estimate is retained. Cooking time is 11 minutes to match the listed timers.
